title: "Aakriti's Animint Gallery"
output: 
  html_document:
    self_contained: false
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat('<table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Screenshot</th><th>Project</th><th>Links</th></tr></thead><tbody>')

for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  repo <- gsub("aakritixyz/", "", trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo[i]))
  
  # We construct the URL components separately
  base <- "[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)"
  img_path <- paste0(repo, "/Capture.PNG")
  demo_url <- paste0(base, repo, "/")
  
  cat('<tr>')
  
  # TECHNICAL TRICK: 
  # We break the "https://" string so Pandoc's parser doesn't catch it.
  # We use the HTML entity for the colon (&#58;) and slashes (&#47;)
  safe_url <- paste0("https&#58;&#47;&#47;aakritixyz.github.io&#47;", img_path)
  
  cat('<td><img src="', safe_url, '" width="250" style="border:1px solid #eee;"></td>', sep="")
  cat('<td><b>', dt$title[i], '</b></td>', sep="")
  cat('<td><a href="', demo_url, '">Interactive Demo</a></td>', sep="")
  
  cat('</tr>')
}

cat('</tbody></table>')
